context.user_story: As a developer, I want the shot detection algorithm to pass all test videos incrementally, adding one video at a time, so that regressions are caught immediately and the algorithm generalizes properly.
acceptance_criteria: Discover all test videos from test-data/ directory (sorted alphabetically)
For each video N: run iterative fix loop on videos 1 through N until all pass
Each 'level' (videos 1..N) has its own max attempts counter that resets when level passes
Shot start detected within ±3 frames (expandable to ±5 if within 4)
Shot end detected within ±3 frames (expandable to ±5 if within 4)
Orientation matches exactly for each video
algorithm-learnings.md updated after each fix attempt
Final state: all videos pass with consistent algorithm
edge_cases: Adding video N breaks previously passing videos 1..N-1 - must fix regression before proceeding
Max attempts reached at any level - stop and report to user with detailed analysis
No test videos found - report and exit successfully
context.data_model: algorithm-learnings.md sections: What Works, What Doesn't Work, Key Observations, Current Algorithm Summary, History. Track current level (N) and attempts at each level.
context.technical_notes: INCREMENTAL PROCESS: (1) Create algorithm-learnings.md. (2) Discover videos [v1, v2, v3, ...] from test-data/. (3) LEVEL 1: Run test-runner on v1 only. If fail, analyze and fix (up to max attempts). Reset attempts when v1 passes. (4) LEVEL 2: Run test-runner on v1+v2. If fail, analyze and fix. If fix breaks v1, fix regression first. Reset attempts when both pass. (5) LEVEL 3: Run on v1+v2+v3. Continue pattern. (6) Stop when all videos pass OR max attempts reached at any level. ANALYSIS PROCESS: When test fails, examine labeled frames (±threshold) in poses.json - what makes them correct? Examine detected frames - why incorrectly chosen? Update algorithm. Update learnings. CREATIVE FREEDOM: Algorithm can be redesigned. May detect shot end first. May combine signals. Goal is consistent calculation.
